import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Observable } from 'rxjs'; import { CardPrincipal } from 'src/app/models/card-principal.model'; import { CardService } from 'src/app/services/card/card.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-home', templateUrl: './home.component.html', styleUrls: ['./home.component.css'] }) export class HomeComponent implements OnInit{ public cardPrincipal: CardPrincipal[] = []; constructor( private cardService: CardService ) {} ngOnInit() { this.loadCards(); } loadCards() { this.cardService.getCards() .subscribe( next => { if (Array.isArray(next)) { this.cardPrincipal.push(...next); } }, error => { console.log("error") } ) } }
